decisions.reason: The naval vessel lighting system should be kept because it still appears on the website and fits the firm's strong position in robust, standards-compliant specialist lighting for demanding transport and marine environments.
The spring-balanced desk lamp should be dropped because it disappeared from the website by 2024 and looks less central to this large firm's application-focused professional lighting portfolio.
The general interior lighting luminaire should be kept because it is a core product type for the firm's building markets and remains visible on the website after launch.
The pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics should be kept because it supports the firm's office and institutional lighting offer and was still being highlighted as a recent release in 2024.
The marine searchlight should be kept because it remains on the website and aligns well with the firm's specialist outdoor and transport lighting capabilities.
